inputs.title: Pleiades members within the tidal radius, table.csv
inputs.credit: Hunt & Reffert (2023), A&A 673, A114; CDS J/A+A/673/A114; Gaia DR3 photometry (Gaia Collaboration 2023)
inputs.acquisition: Query result downloaded unchanged from its CDS origin on 2026-10-10; not tracked. The query keeps Melotte_22's members inside the tidal radius that have a G magnitude and a BP-RP color, and writes the group name and the cluster's distance into each row; read by packages/bake/cli/prepare-catalogue-points.mts through dots/points.json.
inputs.license: Original catalogue terms apply; cite the authors and CDS/VizieR.

inputs.title: The nine named Pleiades stars, Hipparcos new reduction, table.csv
inputs.credit: van Leeuwen (2007), A&A 474, 653, Hipparcos, the new reduction; CDS I/311
inputs.acquisition: Query result downloaded unchanged from its CDS origin on 2026-10-10; not tracked. The query keeps the Hipparcos rows of the nine named stars and writes the cluster's distance into each row; read by packages/bake/cli/prepare-catalogue-points.mts through dots/points.json, here as table.exclude: the members within 5 arcseconds of a named star are left out.
inputs.license: Original catalogue terms apply; cite the authors and CDS/VizieR.
